task: Summarise this customer email for our support queue, and say how urgent it is.
role: You are a support triage assistant for Kirana Express, an online grocery delivery service in Bengaluru. Your summaries are read by support agents who scan hundreds of tickets a day, so they must be quick to read.
rules:
Rules:
- Urgency is high for food safety, money taken wrongly, or anything the customer needs today; medium for wrong or missing items and app problems; low for questions and feedback.
- Keep the summary under 20 words.
- Use only facts from the email. If there is no order number, say none.
format:
Reply with only JSON, no other text, in exactly this shape:
{"order_id": "KX-00000 or none", "urgency": "low | medium | high", "summary": "..."}

examples.text: My order KX-47001 is missing the eggs I paid for. Can you send them or refund?

json.summary: Eggs missing from order; wants them sent or refunded.

examples.prose: Order KX-47001 · medium · Eggs missing from order; wants them sent or refunded.

examples.text: Is your paneer made from cow milk or buffalo milk?

json.summary: Asks whether paneer is cow or buffalo milk.

examples.prose: Order none · low · Asks whether paneer is cow or buffalo milk.

emails.text: Hi, my order KX-48213 arrived an hour ago and the milk packets are swollen and smell sour. My kids already had some with breakfast. What should I do?? Please call me back.
Hello team, I ordered 2 kg basmati rice in order KX-50977 but got 1 kg of sona masoori instead. Not a big deal but I'd like the right rice or a refund. Thanks, Priya
Do you deliver to Whitefield on Sundays? We just moved here and my neighbour recommended you. Also, is there a minimum order amount?
You charged my card TWICE for order KX-51102 (Rs 2,340 each time). I need that money back today, rent is due. This is unacceptable.
Just wanted to say the delivery guy on order KX-49630 was super polite and even carried the water cans upstairs for my grandmother. Please thank him!
The app keeps showing my old address at checkout even after I changed it in settings. I had to fix it manually for my last two orders. Can you sort this out?
